Any change of state.seqs during those awaits goes through pushUndo (17257-17285, which pushes unconditionally at 17285), placing the user's frame ON TOP of the add frame; pullUndo likewise mutates the top before restoring state.seqs. The branch at 26781 is entered precisely when state.seqs changed, so pop() at 26782 then removes the user's frame, not the add frame.
